name: Constitutional equality guarantee
value_2: Text expressly extends rights or equal treatment to foreigners or non-citizens, or to all persons irrespective of nationality
value_1: Universal wording (everyone, every person, all persons) without naming non-citizens, or a citizens-only clause paired with a universal one
value_0: No general equality guarantee, or a guarantee framed for citizens or nationals only

name: Anti-discrimination statute
value_2: A general civil, labor or penal statute lists nationality, citizenship or immigration status as a protected ground
value_1: A statute covers race, ethnicity, colour or national origin, but not nationality or citizenship

name: Hate speech law
value_2: The protected grounds name nationality or citizenship, a nation or national group, or foreigners or migrants
value_1: The protected grounds cover race, ethnicity, colour, religion or national origin only
value_0: No prohibition of group-directed hate speech beyond incitement to imminent violence

name: Migrant-specific equality guarantee
value_2: A migration or foreigners statute guarantees migrants equal treatment or prohibits discrimination against them, with a remedy
value_1: A statute or national plan commits the state to counter xenophobia or discrimination against migrants, without an individual remedy
